name: motd-persistence
description: Practice-box persistence finding: writes an executable script into /etc/update-motd.d so it runs every time the dynamic message of the day is rendered (i.e. at every interactive login on Debian/Ubuntu). Vars: SCRIPT_NAME (required, basename inside /etc/update-motd.d), SNIPPET (required, shell text -- keep it harmless: a printf plus a log append).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu


: "${SCRIPT_NAME:?SCRIPT_NAME is required (basename inside /etc/update-motd.d)}"
: "${SNIPPET:?SNIPPET is required}"

printf '%s\n' "$SNIPPET" > "/etc/update-motd.d/$SCRIPT_NAME"
chmod 0755 "/etc/update-motd.d/$SCRIPT_NAME"
